The failure is caused by the N4 (NMA) bundle shipping with old prerequisite levels (e.g., ci 06.22.04.000) that are not in the ITM‑for‑VE depot.  
Fix it by editing the bundle’s .dsc files (found in <installation_media>/ITMfVE_Agents/unix) so that the prerequisite entries match the levels supplied with the package, e.g.:

```
<PrereqProdCode>ci</PrereqProdCode>
<PrereqVersion>
  <Version>06</Version>
  <Release>30</Release>
  <Mod>05</Mod>
  <Level>
